decision.reason: The '55 Chevy title covers distinct 1982, 1998, and 2006 casting tools; the staged 2025 rows need lineage evidence before a family can be created.
Batman and Robin Batmobile is also used by a separate 2004 100% Hot Wheels casting tool G5513; HYW60/HYX61 need a tool-specific lineage before family creation.

The Nissan Skyline GT-R (BNR32) base display name spans the HYY72 mainline lineage and a structurally different same-scale RLC tool, so the current row remains held until it receives a tool-qualified identity.
